description: This file contains utility functions and classes for structured logging, including masking sensitive headers and values, configuring loggers with JSON formatting, generating request IDs, and sanitizing headers for logging purposes.

classes.name: StructuredJsonFormatter
classes.description: Custom logging formatter that outputs log records as JSON lines suitable for log aggregators.

methods.name: _mask_headers
methods.description: Sanitizes headers by masking sensitive headers and values.
